arxiv-2301-04568.title: Nonlinear Boundary Conditions for Energy and Entropy Stable Initial Boundary Value Problems in Computational Fluid Dynamics
arxiv-2301-04568.creator: Jan Nordström
arxiv-2301-04568.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jan Nordström. We derive new boundary conditions and implementation procedures for nonlinear initial boundary value problems that lead to energy and entropy bounded solutions. A step-by-step procedure for general nonlinear hyperbolic problems on skew-symmetric form is presented. That procedure is subsequently applied to the three most important equations in computational fluid dynamics: the shallow water equations and the incompressible and compressible Euler equations. Both strong and weak imposition of the nonlinear boundary conditions are discussed.

arxiv-2508-03467.creator: Mehdi Dabirnia, Hamdi Joudeh, Albert Guillén i Fàbregas
arxiv-2508-03467.description: Abstract We introduce an expurgation method for source coding with side information that enables direct dual-domain derivations of expurgated error exponents. pmc-11432027.description: Ovarian cysts are linked to hormone imbalances and altered gene expressions, but the connection between cysts and ion channel expression is understudied. pmc-11541505.title: Boronic Acid-Based Glucose Detection for Liver Three-Dimensional Cellular Models
pmc-11541505.creator: Wessal Hussein, Doron Goldberg, Guy Tenzer, Isaac Bentwich, Yossi Haran, Tamar Getter
pmc-11541505.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Liver 3D cell models are regularly employed as a screening platform for predicting the metabolic safety of drugs, by monitoring the physiological responses of the spheroids, through the measurement of relevant markers of normal liver physiology, notably glucose. Measuring glucose levels within the spheroids and their surroundings provides insight into the metabolic homeostasis of liver cells and may be employed as an indication of potential drug-induced toxicity. Several ortho-aminomethyl phenylboronic acid (PDBA) glucose sensors have been developed.

pmc-11544814.title: Pressurized Intraperitoneal Aerosol Chemotherapy for Peritoneal Carcinomatosis in Colorectal Cancer Patients: A Systematic Review of the Evidence

pmc-11544814.description: Simple SummaryThis article stems from my research project on the role of Pressurized Intraperitoneal Aerosol Chemotherapy (PIPAC) in the treatment of peritoneal carcinoma originating from colorectal cancer. Our aim was to assess the existing literature regarding the impact, benefits, and risks associated with PIPAC for patients. The results are encouraging and suggest that PIPAC is a safe option for patients.

pmc-11612188.description: Diabetes foot ulcer (DFU) is one of the common complications of diabetes patients, which may lead to infection, necrosis and even amputation. Current DFU classification methods often require experienced doctors to manually classify the severity, which is time-consuming and low accuracy.

pmc-13669359.creator: Islam M Ibrahim, Rahma A Elkomy, Merna A Mohamed, Fatemah A Farok, Roaa E Emam, Salma A kamel, Reham M Asem
pmc-13669359.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The combination of the Internet of Things (IoT), artificial intelligence (AI), and wearable biosensors is transforming healthcare by allowing continuous, real-time monitoring and more intelligent clinical decision-making. This review explores AI-driven monitoring, smart intravenous (IV) infusion automation, and wearable biosensors, and proposes Intelligent IV Automation and Smart Patient Synchronization (INFUSYNC), a conceptual framework synchronizing monitoring, automated fluid delivery, and predictive analytics.
